intro:
Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power.
Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.
description:
Conquest: Global Domination is a turn-based grand strategy game where every decision can change the balance of power.

Choose from real-world nations or create battles between fictional countries as you compete for global supremacy. Expand your territory, strengthen your economy, develop advanced military technology, and build an army capable of defeating your rivals.

Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, bombers, and other military units to defend your borders or launch large-scale invasions. Research powerful technologies including drones, missile defense systems, and nuclear weapons to gain a strategic advantage over your opponents.

Victory requires more than military strength. Manage your resources carefully, plan your expansion, and decide when to attack, defend, or invest in new technologies. Every turn presents new strategic opportunities and difficult choices.

Play with different victory conditions to suit your preferred style:
• Domination Mode – Conquer 20 countries to become the world's dominant superpower.
• Turn Limit Mode – Earn the highest score before the final turn to claim victory.

Features:

Turn-based global strategy gameplay.
Play as real or fictional nations.
Build and command a modern military.
Recruit infantry, tanks, helicopters, and bombers.
Research drones, nuclear weapons, and missile defense systems.
Capture territories and expand your empire.
Multiple victory conditions for varied gameplay.
High replay value with countless strategic possibilities.

Will your nation become the next global superpower?
